item.tib: dbal gsas khyung nag gi dbang khrid gsal byed 'phrul gyi lde mig
item.coloph: de ltar dbal gsas rngam pa khyung gi dbang khrid gsal byed 'phrul gyi lde mig zhes bya ba/ mkhas grub rnam dag 'od zer gyi dgongs don ci bzhin du/ slob dpon she tsu sa trig gis nan gyis bskul ba la brten nas/ rjes 'jug phyi rabs rnams la phan phyir du/ bru yi sngags 'chang drung mu zur gyi wer ro'i (ros/)rgyal ba'i gdan sa rnam thos pho brang du khrigs su sdeb pa 'di/ 'gal 'khrul mchis na mkhyen ldan gong ma'i tshogs la bzod par gsol/ dge bas 'gro kun bar chod zhi bar shog/
